detail: Restoration contractor specifies three marble entrances, the Green Gate and shrine, Ayyubid minaret and red-stone Gothic envelope on the standing mosque.
Egypt State Information Service places the 1873 construction and 1878 Ottoman minaret and documents the shrine dome.
The conservation archive locates the Ayyubid stucco-panel minaret adjacent to the Green Gate at the mosque’s south corner.
The canopy engineer specifies three 256 square metre fabric roofs, a column on each and peak positioned approximately at the architectural cornice.
